$comment: Inkboard's starter apps: every new workspace gets them in its Apps tab. The briefing is written by the story-briefing specialist on a schedule (UTC).

apps.name: Morning briefing
apps.description: Every desk's briefing before conference: due today, embargoed, unassigned, at risk, published.
apps.brief: Write today's briefing for every {account} that has assignments due today or tomorrow, one section per {account}, by the rulebook: Due today, Embargoed, Unassigned, At risk, Published since the last briefing. Cite every line.

apps.name: Weekend planner
apps.description: Friday afternoon: what is due Saturday and Sunday, and who has it.
apps.brief: Write the weekend briefing: every assignment due Saturday or Sunday, by {account}, with its reporter or nobody, its deadline with its zone, and anything at risk.
